name: MU_AuthorizeNet_ParkingPayment
description: Calls Authorize.net getHostedPaymentPageRequest to obtain a hosted payment form token for a parking registration fee. The returned token is consumed by the front-end Accept.js library to render the Authorize.net hosted payment iframe or lightbox. Run this pipeline from your Experience card / web page on page load; pass the token back to the browser and open the payment form using Accept.js or the hosted-payment iframe URL.

parameters.name: authNetLoginId
parameters.label: Authorize.net API Login ID
parameters.description: Your Authorize.net API Login ID (found in Account > Security Settings > API Credentials).

parameters.name: authNetTransactionKey
parameters.label: Authorize.net Transaction Key
parameters.description: Your Authorize.net Transaction Key (found in Account > Security Settings > API Credentials).

parameters.name: amount
parameters.label: Payment Amount
parameters.description: Dollar amount for the parking registration fee (e.g. '50.00'). Must be a string with exactly two decimal places.

parameters.name: description
parameters.label: Order Description
parameters.description: Short description shown on the Authorize.net payment form and in the transaction record.

parameters.name: invoiceNumber
parameters.label: Invoice / Reference Number
parameters.description: Optional invoice or reference number attached to the transaction (e.g. student ID + term).

parameters.name: returnUrl
parameters.label: Return URL
parameters.description: URL the student is redirected to after a successful payment. Must be HTTPS.

parameters.name: cancelUrl
parameters.label: Cancel URL
parameters.description: URL the student is redirected to if they click Cancel on the payment form. Must be HTTPS.

parameters.name: merchantName
parameters.label: Merchant Name
parameters.description: Merchant name displayed on the hosted payment page.

parameters.name: communicatorUrl
parameters.label: IFrame Communicator URL
parameters.description: URL of the Accept.js communicator page used for postMessage communication when embedding the form in an iframe. Required when using the iframe embed mode; omit when using the lightbox / redirect mode.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.description: Use 'sandbox' while testing against apitest.authorize.net. Switch to 'production' for live transactions.
